headline: BTC testing VWAP reaction zone
summary: Price is interacting with VWAP after prior displacement. This is a watch condition, not an entry call.
evidence_packets: Price is near VWAP after moving away from prior structure.
No-trade if chop develops around VWAP.
confirmation_needed: Clean reaction away from VWAP with structure confirmation from microstructure module.
invalidation: Slow chop around VWAP or clean acceptance through the zone without rejection.
retail_translation: VWAP is not a magic buy/sell line. The signal is how price behaves around it.
